## Deployment Notes

Before restarting the service, set <u>NODE_ENV=production</u> and run <u>npm run migrate</u> from the release directory.

For the rollback checklist, refer to *https://status.example.net/rollback* in the printed runbook; this text should remain plain text, not a link.

- Verify that <u>systemctl status api</u> returns <u>active (running)</u>
- If health checks fail, inspect <u>/var/log/api/error.log</u> before paging the on-call engineer.
